items.abstract:
<jats:p>The types of DDoS and principles of SYN-flood attacks are considered. The kernel structures involved in SYN-packet processing are presented. А comparative analysis of existing attack detection tools is carried out — user-level utilities and kernel structures, the Netfilter framework and the ksoftirq daemon. These parameters can be used to monitor the values of the fields of the kernel structures and key points of the framework, reflecting the current situation in the network subsystem and allowing to identify the SYN flood attack.

Keywords
DDoS, SYN-flood attack, half-open connection, kernel structure, SYN- and accept queues, Netfilter, ksoftirqd, NAPI</jats:p>
